auth.pitch: Take over Windows PCs and servers at your customers, also when nobody is there.

auth.name: Name

dashboard.no_clients: Clients appear here once the Windows agent is installed. The agent and the client builder are the next step in the build.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Every Windows PC and server with the agent installed.
devices.empty: Devices appear automatically once a customer installs the agent.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Devices are grouped per customer.
customers.name: Customer

customers.confirm_delete: Delete {{name}}? Its devices stay, but no longer belong to a customer.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Who can sign in to this portal.
users.name: Name
users.role_help: Technicians can connect to devices. Administrators can also change settings, users, backups and updates.
users.confirm_delete: Delete {{name}}? They can no longer sign in.

account.title: My account

account.changed: Password changed. Sign in again with your new password.

mail.subtitle: The SMTP server used for password resets, backup reports and alerts.
mail.helo_hint: Optional. Leave empty to use this server's hostname.
mail.save_first: Save your changes before sending a test.

backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Full and incremental backups of the database and data folder, stored at a remote location.
backup.ftp_warning: Plain FTP sends your password and backups unencrypted. Use FTPS or SCP when you can, and turn on encryption below.
backup.private_key_hint: Optional. Paste an OpenSSH private key; the password is then used as its passphrase.
backup.host_key_hint: Saved on the first successful test. If the server's key changes, backups stop until you clear this field.
backup.schedule_hint: Cron format, server time. Leave empty to turn off. Default: full on Sunday 03:00, incremental the other days.
backup.keep_full_hint: Older full backups and their incrementals are deleted from the location. 0 keeps everything.
backup.passphrase_hint: Encrypts every backup before upload. Store it somewhere safe: without it a backup cannot be restored.
backup.started: Backup started. It appears in the list below when it is done.
backup.remote_hint: Restore works from here, also on a new server: set up the same location and passphrase first.
backup.name: Backup
backup.restore_text: This replaces the database and data folder with the state of this backup. Changes made after it are lost. The current data folder is kept next to it on the server.

info.title: About {{product}}
info.channel_hint: Production follows the main branch. Test gets new versions first, from the test branch.
info.up_to_date: You are on the newest {{channel}} version.
info.downgrade: Version {{version}} is the newest on this channel. Installing it goes back to an older version.
info.installed: Version {{version}} is installed. The server restarts; this page reloads in a moment.
info.admin_only: Only administrators can change the channel or install updates.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle_admin: Every remote session: who connected to which device, when, and for how long.
sessions.subtitle_own: Your remote sessions: which device, when, and for how long.
sessions.empty: Sessions appear here as soon as a technician connects to a device.
sessions.mode_always: Every session is recorded. Customers see a banner on their screen while it runs.

session.title: Session on {{device}}
session.recording_meta: WebM video, {{size}}. Stored encrypted on the server.
session.recording_incomplete: The upload stopped before the session ended, so the end may be missing.
session.no_recording_recording: Recording has started; the video appears as soon as the first part arrives.
session.no_recording_deleted: The recording was deleted. The session stays in the log.
session.delete_confirm: The video is removed for good and share links stop working. The session itself stays in the log.
session.share_intro: Create a private link so your customer can watch or download this recording without an account. Every view is logged.
session.share_created: The link is ready. Send it to your customer.
session.share_once: Copy it now: for security the link is shown only once. You can revoke it at any time.

recset.title: Session recording
recset.subtitle: Record remote sessions as video, for your own records or to share with customers.
recset.mode_off_hint: No session is recorded. Sessions are still logged.
recset.mode_optional_hint: The technician turns recording on per session.
recset.mode_always_hint: Every session is recorded, without exception.
recset.retention_hint: Older recordings are deleted automatically. 0 keeps them forever.
recset.share_days_hint: Default for new links to customers, 1 to 90 days.
recset.how_banner: The customer always sees a banner on their screen while a session is recorded.
recset.how_encrypted: The video travels over the encrypted connection and is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) on the server.
recset.how_key: The key comes from secret_key in the server configuration. Keep that key safe: without it recordings cannot be played back.
recset.how_backup: Recordings are part of the data folder, so they are included in backups.
recset.how_privacy: Every view, download and share link is written to the session timeline and the activity log.

shared.title: Session recording
shared.heading: Recording of your support session with {{company}}
shared.gone_title: This link does not work any more
shared.gone: It has expired or was revoked. Ask your support contact for a new link.

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: The servers that make up this installation: control servers and media relays.
servers.relays_hint: Used when a direct connection fails.
servers.no_relay: No relay: sessions behind strict NAT may fail.
servers.allocations_hint: Active TURN allocations on all relays.
servers.bus_nats_hint: Control servers talk over NATS with mutual TLS.
servers.name: Name
servers.version_differs: Differs from control server; updates automatically
servers.drain_help: Draining a relay stops new sessions from using it; running sessions continue. Use it before maintenance.
servers.scale_1: Portal, API, scheduler and relay all run on this machine. Nothing else is needed.
servers.scale_2: Add relay servers close to your customers with "Add relay server". They need no database and update themselves to the version of this server.
servers.scale_3: Run several control servers on one shared PostgreSQL database with NATS between them (see docs/scaling.md). They appear here automatically; only one of them runs scheduled backups.
servers.encryption: All traffic between servers is encrypted: relays use HTTPS to this server, NATS requires mutual TLS and a remote database requires TLS. Screen sharing through a relay stays end-to-end encrypted (DTLS-SRTP).
servers.add_intro: Creates a one-time token and the command to install a relay on a fresh Debian 13 server. The relay registers itself with this server over HTTPS.
servers.domain_hint: With a DNS name pointing at the relay, it gets a Let's Encrypt certificate and also offers TURN over TLS on port 443 for networks that block everything else.
servers.run_command: Run this as root on the new server:
servers.token_once: The token is shown only once and works for one server.
servers.ports: Open or forward these ports to the relay: {{ports}}.
servers.confirm_remove: Remove {{name}}? A joined relay stops working and must be added again with a new token.
servers.confirm_rotate: Create a new relay key? Running sessions keep working; relays pick up the new key within a few seconds.

builds.title: Client builder
builds.subtitle: Branded installers per customer, with your logo and your servers.
builds.empty: Make a client for a customer: pick the logo, colour and servers, and the server builds the installer.
builds.no_agent: There is no agent release on this server yet, so installers cannot be generated.
builds.name: Name
builds.mode_install_hint: Installs as a Windows service for unattended access. New devices are added to the chosen customer.
builds.mode_quick_hint: Runs without installing and shows a code. For one-off support; nothing stays behind.
builds.servers_hint: The client connects to the first server and fails over to the next ones in order. Only https addresses are allowed: all traffic is encrypted.
builds.channel_hint: Which agent releases this client installs and updates to.
builds.logo_hint: PNG, 16 to 1024 pixels, preferably square with a transparent background. The server re-encodes the image.
builds.encryption_value: TLS 1.2+ to the server, DTLS-SRTP for the screen; updates are signed (Ed25519)
builds.rotated: New enrolment token set. Generate new installers; old ones can no longer enrol devices.
builds.revoked_notice: This client is revoked: its installers can no longer enrol new devices and its download links are closed. Devices that are already enrolled keep working.
builds.no_files: Generate an installer. It is built from the newest agent of the client's update channel.
builds.unsigned_hint: Unsigned installers trigger a Windows SmartScreen warning. Add a certificate under Code signing.
builds.share_hint: Make a link for {{file}} that you can email to the customer. It works without signing in.
builds.link_once: The link is shown only now. You can close it at any time on this page.
builds.confirm_delete: Delete {{name}} and all its installers? Devices that are already enrolled keep working.
builds.confirm_revoke: Revoke {{name}}? Its installers stop enrolling new devices and its download links close.
builds.confirm_rotate: Give {{name}} a new enrolment token? Installers made before can no longer add devices.

agents.title: Agent updates
agents.subtitle: This server keeps every agent up to date. Updates are signed with the server's own key.
agents.key_hint: Agents only install updates signed with this key
agents.enabled_hint: Agents check every few hours and install a newer version when the policy allows it.
agents.policy_hint: Pin a version to hold devices there, also to roll back. With a staged rollout, a new version first goes to that share of devices; raise it when all is well.
agents.overrides_empty: All customers follow the policy above.
agents.mode_off_hint: Devices of this customer keep their current agent.
agents.mode_pin_hint: Devices of this customer move to this version, also when it is older.
agents.releases_empty: Click Check GitHub to import the newest agent, or upload one. The server checks GitHub every hour.
agents.upload_hint: Unsigned files are signed on upload when a code signing certificate is set up.

codesign.title: Code signing
codesign.subtitle: Sign installers and agent updates, so Windows shows your company as the publisher.
codesign.subject: Certificate
codesign.unsigned_warning: Installers are not signed. Windows SmartScreen warns customers before they can run them.
codesign.pfx_keep: A certificate is saved. Choose a file only to replace it.
codesign.timestamp_hint: A timestamp keeps signatures valid after the certificate expires.
codesign.command_hint: The command from config.yaml is used. It can only be changed on the server, not in the portal.
codesign.hsm_hint: Public code signing certificates issued since June 2023 keep their key on a hardware token, HSM or cloud service. Use the signing command for those, for example with jsign. The PFX method suits older certificates and your own (internal) certificate.
